bio.text: Glenn Grothman represents Wisconsin's 6th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and was first elected in 2014.
He previously served as Assistant Majority Leader in the Wisconsin State Senate and for 10 years in the Wisconsin State Assembly, and was an attorney and tax preparer.
He earned a business administration degree in accounting and a J.D. from the University of Wisconsin-Madison and lives in the Town of Greenbush in Sheboygan County.
